scope: Local static review of retained E device baseline phase-boundary rejection; no runtime mutation, capture, rerun or retroqualification

Upstream attributes request to answer processing time; post20seconds is called saturation even when no saturation workload runs.
Validator requires exact client scheduled/sent/correct counts yet also exact upstream steady4000. The latter imposes an additional processing-time cutoff beyond request-cohort drain.

Frozen documented CPU denominator covers warmup anddrain and analyzer retains all measured-correct latencies. Exacttimebucket4000 is not intrinsically necessary for fullcohort comparison, but remains binding for the current attempt.
